basic_info.description: Welcome to this renovated residence in highly sought-after Inner Parkside neighborhood. Updated in 2018 and meticulously maintained, this turn-key home blends timeless charm with modern luxury. Enjoy morning walks in the neighborhood with sweeping views of the city and ocean. This home offers elegant designer finishes.  701 Quintara features freshly updated interior, wide-plank engineered hardwood floors, recessed lighting, and a sleek and stylish fireplace that anchors the main living space. The designer kitchen is a showstopper featuring professional-grade appliances, a spacious eat-in island, and sophisticated finishes that make both everyday living and entertaining effortless.  Stylishly remodeled bathrooms offer a spa-like experience. There are 4 full bathrooms, 2 on each level, 3 are en-suite, plus 1 additional half bath on the upper level.    The 4 bedrooms are well-appointed, with ample closets and an abundance of natural light. There are 2 bedrooms on each floor and a common area on each level for casual gathering spaces.     The yard provides a tranquil space for relaxation, dining, and gatherings with friends and family.   Located moments from vibrant West Portal shops, restaurants, and transportation and local parks.
